geometry_role: Frozen schematic substrate used by accepted panel A; not a new fitted network or a map of the F event.

EE_kernel.role: Reference kernel; fitted length scales and angle may vary.

readout.type: normalized Gaussian average of smoothed E spike density
readout.quantity: Firing-density proxy, not an electric/magnetic field or synaptic-current LFP.
readout.waveform_quantity: Actual frozen F-panel 30-80 Hz traces; all contacts share the same amplitude scale.
readout.display_title_meaning: Virtual SEEG contact readout of underlying SNN propagation; firing-density proxy, not measured clinical voltage or a newly computed potential forward model.

display_contract.schematic_neurons: Actual coordinates from the frozen panel A substrate, with sparse deterministic display subsampling.

revised_display: Original left circuit retained; 2D sheet moved 24 mm right toward canvas center; sampling and both readouts narrower. Five irregularly positioned ellipses in 2+3 rows, each with multiple hollow red E triangles and fewer blue I circles. No synaptic arrowheads among neuron symbols.

mode_showcases.observable: Frozen 30-80 Hz contact activity from the F source arrays, cropped to two 120-ms three-contact burst sequences.
mode_showcases.distinction_from_F: A: two short three-contact mechanism readouts, fixed channel order, shared gain; F: continuous 15-contact long record and event marks.
mode_showcases.selection: Reuse both F demonstration events, fixed channel order ICL8/ICL6/ICL4 across the two modes; no temporal shifting or per-contact amplitude scaling.

sampling_zoom.two_zoom_roles: Left zoom is representative circuit away from electrodes; new right zoom is explicitly local electrode sampling.
sampling_zoom.geometry: Same frozen neuron population and same display-only rigid contacts as overview; both use the E-panel rod projection. Local kernels are illustrative operators, not reconstructed graph edges.

electrode_display.rule: Reuse current E panel rigid rod projections; schematic display only, no simulation coordinates or readout traces changed.

overview_neuron_samples.sampling: Exact old overview scatter coordinates retained; raster replaced with vector scatter for straight rod drawing.

local_population_display.purpose: Schematic local connection neighbourhoods; ellipse contours are not fitted core boundaries.
local_population_display.sampling: Deterministic subsampling of the frozen E/I coordinates inside each ellipse; retain physical orientation and scale.
local_population_display.E_markers: Uniform hollow red triangles, including peripheral neurons.
local_population_display.I_markers: Blue circular neurons in every ellipse, fewer than E neurons.
